mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.public_id AS publicId, p.type, p.name, p.branch_name AS branchName, p.address, p.location_detail AS locationDetail, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.business_hours AS businessHours, p.holiday_info AS holidayInfo, p.phone, p.description, (SELECT pi.image_url FROM place_images pi WHERE pi.place_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS imageUrl FROM favorites f JOIN places p ON p.id = f.place_id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
